source: WO-050 — the create-path request fixture, not a recorded response

decisions.title: Populate every field this binding provisions
decisions.problem: A create path that sends only a summary writes a bare title into a Space provisioned for seven custom fields, so the imported record carries none of the contract that made it a ticket.
decisions.solution: Send the whole decision as one create request: the description headings, the labels, and each of the seven custom fields under the id this site assigns it.

rationale.choice: One field table, read by the script that creates the fields and by the script that fills them.
rejected: A second hardcoded list in the create path: it drifts at the first rename.
Hardcoded customfield ids: a field id copied from one site is a wrong field on the next.

decisions.out_of_scope: Provisioning the Space, and linking blocked_by, which needs its target to exist first.
human_steps: Create the Jira API token and export WORK_ORDER_JIRA_TOKEN.
Confirm the target project key before the first live run.
decisions.verify:
plugins/work-order-jira/selftest.sh
plugins/work-order-jira/provider.sh --dry-run create WO Task s \
  --ticket plugins/work-order-jira/fixtures/ticket-full.json
decisions.verify_fails_today: create takes a summary and nothing else, so the dry-run body carries no description.
decisions.outcome: Carried so this fixture exercises all seven provisioned fields.
blocked_by_external: the Jira site enabling the textarea searcher, https://example.test/support/4711
